exact_statement: For every Boolean seed f on n>=1 uniform bits with I(f)>0, the explicit basis-character tagged family F_t(x,a,b)=(-1)^(a dot b+c_b dot x)g_t(x), g_t=z product of t disjoint copies of f, k_t=tn+1, m_t=ceil(log2(k_t+1)), N_t=2^m_t, c_b=e_b for b<k_t and zero otherwise, has pairwise distinct bent data branches, dependent spectral marginals with mutual information >=h2(1/N_t), H(F_t)=tH(f)+2m_t and I(F_t)=tI(f)+J_t with m_t<J_t<m_t+2; hence its full H/I tends to H(f)/I(f). The optimal FEI constant on distinct correlated bent-branch address selectors equals the universal constant, possibly infinity. For every bent-branch selector with d data bits, H=d+E H(sigma_t), I=d/2+E I(sigma_t) with Boolean phase rows sigma_t, so a violation at C>=2 descends to a smaller phase row. For F=(-1)^(a dot b)h_b(x), a physical b-first paired stopping tree removes exactly 2m entropy and m influence while retaining E H(h_b), and aggregate erasure B(F)=m+E B(h_b)+sum_j H(S_j|V,S_-j).

Full physical restriction closure of unbounded ordinary addressing contains every Boolean sign, so a conditional bound on that closure is FEI-strength.
